info.name: BoxTrack API
info.description: Every request has assertions - run the whole collection in order (Postman Runner, or `npx newman run docs/postman/BoxTrack.postman_collection.json`) against an API seeded with `npm run db:setup -- --seed`. It logs in with the demo coach, creates its own session on a random 2030 date, exercises the optional tier, cleans up after itself and logs out. Field-by-field contract: backend/API_CONTRACT.md.

item.name: Login - unknown email gets the same answer

exec: pm.test('Returns a token and the user role', () => { pm.expect(body.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.be.oneOf(['owner', 'coach', 'staff']); });

item.name: 2 - Security - admin routes reject unauthenticated calls
Create session with a forged token

exec: pm.test('Returns an array sorted by start_time', () => { const w = pm.response.json().wods; pm.expect(w).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(w.map((s) => s.start_time)).to.eql([...w.map((s) => s.start_time)].sort()); });

pm.test('Has the TV contract keys', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.include.keys('reference_date', 'reference_time', 'timezone', 'current', 'next', 'remaining'); pm.expect(b.timezone).to.eql('Europe/Paris'); });
